label: Build APK
command: fvm flutter build apk --dart-define-from-file=env.json && open build/app/outputs/flutter-apk

label: Build App Bundle
command: fvm flutter build appbundle --dart-define-from-file=env.json && open build/app/outputs/bundle/release

label: Build IPA
command: fvm flutter build ipa --dart-define-from-file=env.json && open build/ios/ipa
